note: Campground with a bar and grill on 200-acre Bear Lake, on WI-22 north of Manawa. Mostly seasonal: about 99 of its roughly 210 sites are sold by the night. The lakefront sites line the shore under tall pines, one with its own small sand beach; the lakefront double sits beside the bar and its weekend tiki hut and is never quiet. Full hook-up sites 401-412 run along the highway behind a tree line. Opens when the frost is out of the ground; the water is shut off on the third Monday in October. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates, site types, FAQ, rules, map), Campspot and Google read. Price gate passes at $50 (basic summer site; Campspot $48). Nightly share ~47% (99 nightly of ~209; ~110 seasonal on the map) -> keep with the 'Mostly seasonal' line. 2-night minimum, 3 on holiday weekends (not a 3+ standing minimum). Lakefront kept on the private-beach site L4 and the lakefront double.
flags: LONG-STAY: ~99 nightly sites (Campspot) of ~209 (~110 pink 'Seasonal Site' on the operator's map) = ~47% nightly, inside the 10-50% keep-with-caveat band; the note says so. Seasonal $2,600 / $3,200 posted beside nightly rates; no wording discourages nightly guests. Google 4.5 from 633 reviews.

PRICE GATE: passes. Ordinary RV site (basic water/electric) $50/nt on the operator's 2026 rate page, $48 quoted on Campspot (Oct 2026); premium types run $56-63 (private beach $85, double $116). Not a Good Sam Park (directory row isGsPark false); no gateway within 40 km. At the line: a 2027 increase of even $1 on the basic site would fail it.
MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights always, 3 on Memorial Day / Fourth of July / Labor Day weekends (FAQ). Not a standing 3+ minimum. The stored min_stay lacked the holiday rule.

WATERFRONT: stored lakefront (a Claude value) kept. Site L4 ('Lakefront with Private Beach', its own sand beach at the water's edge, ~44.4110,-88.9384) and the Lakefront Double Site ('right on the lake', beside the bar's open grassy beach, ~44.4115,-88.9378) are at the water over open ground, both sold nightly ($85, $116). Lakefront sites L2-L12 (L5-L12 nightly on Campspot, along the shore ~44.4110,-88.9384 to ~44.4098,-88.9395) sit under a continuous tall-pine canopy on imagery; their Campspot photos show bare ground under high trunks to the water ~10-20 m off. By the canopy rule those are views, so the value rests on L4 and the double; the reviewer may prefer lakefront with a caveat naming them.

SEASON: no dates posted. 'We open when the frost is out of the ground... The water is shut off on the third Monday in October' (2027: October 18); Campspot shows the resort closed in late November. Season group left unwritten.
Not age-restricted (the 21+ rule is for renting a site). ATV/UTVs may be driven from the site to the county roads only; not an OHV park.
